categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Tests' label and adds unit test stream formatting utilities in 'src/test/util/common.{h,cpp}' across multiple test suites.
categories.rationale: Improves unit test diagnostics by allowing assertion failures to print mismatched values instead of bare boolean failures across 15 test suites. When 'BOOST_CHECK(a == b)' failed previously, 'Boost only reports a boolean failure without printing the values', which hindered debugging test failures.
